sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels) (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (werdenfels).
Our order history for this part shows 5.26 EUR (po:4500013373-10) against 5.84 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014427-10).
Our volume forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).
Today you supply 20 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 24-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,700 kg per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract and the prospect of a larger share of your volume. 

While we cannot provide a detailed cost breakdown due to company policy, we acknowledge your historical price points. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Building on your first package with the AS-14404 index clause and 30-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.50 per unit.

Our Angebot comprises a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our offer features a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

We welcome the 36-month contract term, but we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause as fixed prices are not feasible. Taking up your offer to pay faster for a better price, we propose 30-day payment terms to support a reduction to €5.40. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net, and we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Please provide the data backing your volume commitment so we can fully incorporate it into our evaluation. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
